rows.location: course/modules/AC/AC2/L04.html Remark 2.4 first sentence (line 138)
rows.evidence: The sentence says: 'If A3 fails, so that current liabilities contain short-term debt, the financing flow Delta STD no longer cancels'. Under A3 failing with A4 as written (CFF = Delta LTD - D), the Proposition 2.2 form holds exactly (l04_exact.py, row 'A3' with A4 literal': prop22_form failures 0 in 3000). The debt change is then inside Delta CL and produces no extra term (the gap is only (dONCA - dONCL)/TA-bar). The extra Delta STD term appears only when the cash-flow statement books Delta STD in financing, i.e. under A4'. So A3 failing alone does not make the flow fail to cancel; the sentence states the cause incompletely. The round-2 suggestion ('the financing flow Delta STD no longer cancels') was adopted without this qualifier.
